title: Returning to the Gallery keeps a media-hungry operation selected, so Run just refuses
description: Coming back to the Gallery workspace from History leaves whatever operation was active still selected. If the PromptBox has no image, the op strip stays on a media-hungry op (edit / i2i / upscale) and pressing Run only toasts a missing-input complaint. A less literate user has no idea what is being asked of them. Expected: on entering the Gallery, if the PromptBox holds NO media, fall back to t2i; if it DOES hold media, leave the operation alone. The identical fallback already exists in the Gallery when the user removes the last image from the PromptBox (shipped with MPI-337 / MPI-356), so this is about firing that same path on workspace re-entry rather than inventing new behaviour. User-reported 2026-07-29.
